source: PR #5 (RainyxWang) published validation aggregate, read-only snapshot 2026-09-16
notes: R4 regression round. Derived from another contributor's published confusion matrix. Raw class mapping preserved.

policy.class_list: fixed by the caller and saved in declared order
policy.label_normalisation: raw labels are compared unchanged unless an adapter is requested explicitly; the same adapter is applied to the class list, the target column and the prediction column, and any many-to-one collapse aborts the run instead of merging classes
policy.macro: primary macro F1 averages over every declared class, including classes with zero support; macro_f1_excluding_zero_support is reported separately and is not interchangeable
policy.unusable_rows: abort unless --allow-unknown-labels is given; excluded rows are always written out
policy.official_test: a split name requires --allow-official-test when, ignoring case and separators, it is one of: test, tests, testing, officialtest, testset, testdata, finaltest, holdout, holdouts, holdoutset
policy.confusion_counts: counts must be integers; integral floats such as 1.0 are accepted, anything fractional, negative, non-finite, boolean, textual or out of int64 range is refused
policy.class_indices: class mapping indices must be JSON integers; floats, booleans and strings are refused
policy.expected_rows: checked against the row count in prediction mode and against the matrix total in aggregate mode

matrix_cross_check.reason: aggregate input: there is no second representation to compare against. Recomputing the supplied matrix with the same formula is not an independent check. The independent check for this mode is arithmetic_check, which re-runs the arithmetic with exact rationals.

arithmetic_check.basis: exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction), independent of the numpy path

limitations: Metrics describe the supplied split only; they are not official test scores unless the split says so.
Uncalibrated scores are recorded but never used by the metrics.
Macro F1 treats every declared class equally, including classes with tiny support.
public_export_note: Execution command omitted from the published copy to avoid personal absolute paths; the reproduction commands are in docs/CLASSIFICATION_EVALUATION.md.
